name: Lawn.Smart - USDA Zone-Intelligent Lawn Care
text: A fully redesigned USDA zone-customized lawn care PWA built with React and Tailwind CSS. The v2 release introduces a complete UI overhaul designed with Claude Design — featuring a three-column desktop layout, purpose-built mobile experience with bottom navigation, and a semantic design token system for consistent styling across all components.
description: V2 highlights include a Dashboard, Calendar, History, and Settings tab structure; a pinned Critical Task hero card on mobile; month pill navigation; time-aware greetings; and soft amber alert styling replacing the original harsh dark-on-dark cards. New features include a Calendar view with task dot indicators, a yearly History tracker, a monthly notes journal, and a sidebar category filter. Amazon product recommendations now use brand-consistent dark green buttons. Covers all 50 US states and hardiness zones 3a–11b.

name: Cloud Status Hub
text: Real-time operational status dashboard unifying AWS, Azure, OCI, and GCP health into a single view. Built with React 18, Vite, and TypeScript, with Vercel Functions handling the Azure feed proxy and backend alerting logic.
description: Auto-refreshes every 60 seconds and shows active incidents, per-service health, and regional impact across all four major cloud providers. Subscribers can opt in to email alerts (via Resend) when a followed provider reports a new outage, with an admin dashboard gated behind Sign in with Vercel. Backed by Neon Postgres, Vercel BotID for bot protection, and an AWS EventBridge cron to poll status every 5 minutes.

name: AWS Services Dashboard
text: A comprehensive real-time monitoring platform providing visibility into AWS infrastructure across multiple accounts and regions. Built with React 18, Vite, and TanStack Query on the frontend, with AWS Lambda, EventBridge, and S3 on the backend.
description: Features real-time service monitoring, regional deployment tracking, geographic resource analysis, Excel report generation, and infrastructure change monitoring. Fully automated infrastructure provisioned with Terraform, deployed via GitHub Actions CI/CD, and distributed globally through CloudFront CDN.

name: Next.js Personal Portfolio
text: Modern, responsive personal portfolio and blog built with Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Features static site generation with 16 pre-rendered pages, comprehensive SEO optimization with Open Graph and Twitter Cards.
description: Deployed to AWS S3 with CloudFront CDN for global edge caching. Includes technology leadership insights, cloud architecture discussions, and project showcases. Migrated from Gatsby to Next.js for improved developer experience and modern React patterns.

name: Tesla Dashboard
text: A comprehensive React-based dashboard designed for Tesla vehicle browsers, providing location-based weather, traffic conditions, news updates, and nearby points of interest.
description: Features real-time weather with detailed forecasts, live news feeds, traffic conditions via Waze integration, and GPS location detection. Built with React 18 and Tailwind CSS with a Tesla-themed dark UI optimized for in-vehicle use.

name: AWS Health Notifications
text: Automated AWS Health Event notification system with enhanced formatting and multi-environment support. Built with Terraform, this project provides real-time monitoring of AWS service health events with customizable email and SMS alerts.
description: Features secure CI/CD deployment through GitHub Actions, modular infrastructure design, and comprehensive monitoring across development and production environments. Developed using AI-assisted pair programming techniques for optimal code quality and documentation.

name: AWS Multi-region Hosted Site
text: Production-grade and fully redundant site within Amazon Web Services. Multi-region hosting, CDN caching and automated TLS key renewals. All AWS resources built and configured using Terraform code and fully automated.
description: Instead of going with a hosting provider like Netlify or Vercel, I wanted to create my own production-grade infrastructure. Features multi-region failover, CloudFront CDN, automated certificate management, and infrastructure as code.

name: AWS RSS Status Check Site
text: Serverless AWS RSS monitoring system built with Terraform infrastructure-as-code. Features EventBridge Scheduler triggering Lambda functions to scan vendor RSS feeds, DynamoDB for state management and duplicate detection.
description: Includes multi-environment support (dev/prod), comprehensive CloudWatch monitoring, cost optimization with reserved concurrency, and automatic TTL cleanup. Architecture demonstrates AWS best practices with IAM roles, efficient memory allocation, and Node.js 20.x runtime.

name: My Lawn
text: A custom blend of Kentucky Bluegrass and Perennial Rye. Working on my lawn is one of my favorite projects - nothing makes me prouder than seeing those vibrant lawn stripes while I sit outside with family and friends to enjoy a nice BBQ.
description: This project showcases attention to detail and dedication to quality results. Features professional lawn care techniques, seasonal maintenance schedules, and optimal mowing patterns for aesthetic appeal.
